FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something strange. The king, a stout and regal figure with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his advisors, a group of stern-looking men in suits.

KING (he) "I have had enough of this drab, medieval aesthetic. It's time for a change. I want our kingdom to be the most...futuristic...of all time."

ADVISOR 1 (he) "But, sire, what do you mean? We're a medieval kingdom, after all."

KING (he) "Exactly. That's why it's time for a revolution. I want our architecture to be a fusion of ancient and modern, with a dash of...vaporwave."

ADVISOR 2 (he) "Vaporwave? I'm not sure I understand, sire."

KING (he) "It's a style, my friends. A style that combines the nostalgia of the past with the futurism of the future. Think...retro-futurism."

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king is surrounded by his advisors, who are all staring at him in confusion.

KING (he) "I want our castle to be a giant, neon-lit, holographic palace. With...fog machines."

ADVISOR 3 (he) "Fog machines, sire?"

KING (he) "Yes, fog machines. And...lasers. We'll need a lot of lasers."

ADVISOR 4 (he) "But, sire, what about the, uh, historical accuracy of our architecture?"

KING (he) "Historical accuracy? Ha! Who needs that when you can have...vaporwave?"

CUT TO:

EXT. KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is transformed. The castle is now a giant, neon-lit, holographic palace, with fog machines and lasers everywhere. The king's advisors are all dressed in futuristic, vaporwave-inspired clothing, complete with neon-colored wigs and sunglasses.

KING (he) "Behold, my friends! Our kingdom is now the most...futuristic...of all time."

ADVISOR 1 (he) "It's...um... quite a sight, sire."

KING (he) "I know, right? I'm loving it. And I want our people to dress like this too."

CUT TO:

EXT. KINGDOM - DAY

The peasants are now all dressed in futuristic, vaporwave-inspired clothing, complete with neon-colored wigs and sunglasses. They're all walking around, looking like they just stepped out of a sci-fi movie.

KING (he) "I want our kingdom to be a place where the past and future collide. Where the medieval and the modern coexist in perfect harmony."

ADVISOR 2 (he) "It's...um... quite a vision, sire."

KING (he) "I know, right? I'm a visionary. And I want our kingdom to be the most...futuristic...of all time."

CUT TO:

EXT. KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now a giant, neon-lit, holographic palace, with fog machines and lasers everywhere. The king is standing on the balcony, looking out over the kingdom.

KING (he) "I'm so glad I made this change. Our kingdom is now the most...futuristic...of all time."

ADVISOR 3 (he) "It's...um... quite a sight, sire."

KING (he) "I know, right? I'm loving it. And I want our kingdom to be a place where the past and future collide. Where the medieval and the modern coexist in perfect harmony."

FADE TO BLACK.
